name: Emergency Eye
description: Chemical burns, open globes, retrobulbar hemorrhage, GCA/AION, endophthalmitis, retinal detachment, acute angle closure, and trauma protocols.

episodes.title: Triage in the Emergency Eye: What Cannot Wait
episodes.description: The immediate versus urgent versus semi-urgent framework and the red-flag symptoms that demand same-day care.

episodes.title: Chemical Burns: The Irrigation That Saves Sight
episodes.description: The copious, continuous, immediate irrigation, the Morgan lens, the pH target, and the limbal ischemia grading.

episodes.title: Open Globe: The Signs You Cannot Miss
episodes.description: The peaked pupil, the shallow chamber, the oculocardiac reflex, and the shield-and-no-manipulation protocol.

episodes.title: Retrobulbar Hemorrhage: The Sight-Threatening Compression
episodes.description: The tight orbit, the afferent pupillary defect, and the lateral canthotomy that decompresses.

episodes.title: Giant Cell Arteritis: The Same-Day Steroid
episodes.description: The jaw claudication, the ESR/CRP, and the immediate high-dose steroid before the biopsy.

episodes.title: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion: The 90-Minute Window
episodes.description: The cherry-red spot, the ocular massage, the anterior chamber paracentesis, and the stroke workup.

episodes.title: Acute Angle Closure: The Stone in the Eye
episodes.description: The mid-dilated pupil, the corneal edema, and the immediate pressure-lowering and laser iridotomy.

episodes.title: Endophthalmitis: The Post-Op and Post-Trauma Nightmare
episodes.description: The hypopyon, the pain, the vitreous tap, and the intravitreal antibiotics that race the clock.

episodes.title: Retinal Detachment: The Curtain and the Photopsia
episodes.description: The flashes, floaters, and curtain triad, the dilated fundus exam, and the urgent surgical referral.

episodes.title: Corneal Ulcer: The Sight-Threatening Infection
episodes.description: The infiltrate, the epithelial defect, the culture decision, and the fortified antibiotic protocol.

episodes.title: Hyphema: The Blood in the Anterior Chamber
episodes.description: The grading, the rebleed risk, the sickle cell screen, and the activity restriction and elevation.

episodes.title: Traumatic Iritis: The Ciliary Spasm and the Steroid
episodes.description: The cells and flare, the photophobia, and the cycloplegia and steroid that ease the pain.

episodes.title: Traumatic Optic Neuropathy: The Vision Loss After Injury
episodes.description: The afferent defect, the CT for canal fracture, and the steroid and surgical controversy.

episodes.title: Eyelid Laceration: The Canalicular and the Margin
episodes.description: When to repair at the chair, the canalicular involvement that needs OR, and the tetanus update.

episodes.title: Intraocular Foreign Body: The Hidden Metal
episodes.description: The high-speed history, the dilated exam, the CT localization, and the magnetic resonance contraindication.
